name: Rin
source:
Rin possesses the blood of a princess whom was deemed inferior against the previous queen. Treated like a slave, he wasn't even allowed to wear clothes. However, he was able to go on thanks to his natural cheerfulness. His good, honest heart is slowly warped into darkness due to Kaguya's influence.

[Based on the translation of the official website profile.]
